snapshot.title: Integrate Obsidian with Knowns
snapshot.description:
This is placed into the backlog since it's not urgently required yet, but it would be really cool if these could be integrated.

I think a relatively simple starting point would be to have multiple repos inside one Knowns project...

The main value proposition I see here is a workflow that combines task management with programming/copilot instructions...but it doesn't have the integration with the other services or mobile apps (like Obsidian does).

Anyway...story for another time. Maybe we can get copilot to scan tickets inside a knowns project and add them to Obsidian - semi-manual process that would be a good start.
